3. Plotting Exercise

a.) $\vec{E}$ field as a function of time and propagation distance

using Plots
# using LaTeXStrings
# gr() 
# plotlyjs()
plotly()


# Constant Definitions
const E_0 = 1.0                         # Amplitude of E-field
const lambda_0 = 555e-9                 # Free-space wavelength (555 nm)
const k_0 = 2 * pi / lambda_0           # Wavenumber
const beta = sqrt(2) * pi / lambda_0    # Beta
const omega = 3e8 * k_0                 # Angular frequency
const y_slice = pi / (2 * beta)         # Defines a single slice of y for plotting

prop_distance_m = range(0, 3 * lambda_0, length=200) 
time_steps_s = range(0, 10e-15, length=7)             

colors = palette(:rainbow, length(time_steps_s))

# Creates background plot
wave_plot = plot(
    title="E Field Evolution Over Time",
    xlabel="Time [fs]",
    ylabel="Propagation Distance [nm]",
    zlabel="Electric Field Amplitude",
    camera=(45, 30),        
    legend=false,           
    size=(800, 600),
)

# Loop that plots the shaded surfaces and borders for each time step
for (i, t) in enumerate(reverse(time_steps_s))
    E_complex = E_0 * sin(beta * y_slice) .* exp.(im .* (omega * t .- beta .* prop_distance_m)) # E field equation
    E = real(E_complex)
    
    # Converts mks units into readable units for plot
    plot_x_fs = fill(t * 1e15, length(prop_distance_m)) 
    plot_y_nm = prop_distance_m .* 1e9  
    
    X_ribbon = [plot_x_fs plot_x_fs]
    Y_ribbon = [plot_y_nm plot_y_nm]
    Z_ribbon = [E zeros(length(E))]
    
    surface!(
        wave_plot,
        X_ribbon,
        Y_ribbon,
        Z_ribbon,
        opacity=0.5,                    
        color=fill(colors[i], size(Z_ribbon)),
        colorbar=false
    )
    
    plot!(
        wave_plot,
        plot_x_fs,
        plot_y_nm,
        E,
        lw=5,
        linecolor=colors[i]
    )
end

wave_plot

b.) Plot of the $\vec{H}$ field at $t=0$

\[ \vec{H}(\vec{r},t) = \frac{\beta E_0}{\mu_0 \omega} [\sin(\beta y) \hat{y} - i \cos(\beta y) \hat{z}] e^{-i(\beta z - \omega t)} \]

at $t=0$

\[ \vec{H}(\vec{r},0) = \frac{\beta E_0}{\mu_0 \omega} [\sin(\beta y) \hat{y} - i \cos(\beta y) \hat{z}] e^{-i\beta z} \]

which using Euler's identity and leaving just the real pieces leaves:

\[ \vec{H}(\vec{y},0) = \frac{\beta E_0}{\mu_0 \omega} [\sin(\beta y) \cos(\beta z)] \]

\[ \vec{H}(\vec{z},0) = -\frac{\beta E_0}{\mu_0 \omega} [\cos(\beta y) \sin(\beta z)] \]

using Plots
plotly()

const mu_0 = 4 * pi * 1e-7          # Permeability of free space

grid_density = 50

# Makes the components of the field
y_vec = range(0, pi/beta, length= grid_density)
z_vec = range(0, 2*lambda_0, length= grid_density)

Ny = length(y_vec)
Nz = length(z_vec)

dy = y_vec[2] - y_vec[1]
dz = z_vec[2] - z_vec[1]


H_coeff = (beta * E_0) / (omega * mu_0)

# Initialize arrays
Hy_analytical = zeros(Ny, Nz)
Hz_analytical = zeros(Ny, Nz)

# Applies equation to each component of the field
for i in 1:Ny, j in 1:Nz
    y = y_vec[i]
    z = z_vec[j]
    Hy_analytical[i, j] = H_coeff * sin(beta * y) * cos(beta * z)
    Hz_analytical[i, j] = -H_coeff * cos(beta * y) * sin(beta * z)
end

z_coords = Float64[]
y_coords = Float64[] 
Hz_a_vals = Float64[]
Hy_a_vals = Float64[]

# Updates values to lists
for i in 2:(Ny-1), j in 2:(Nz-1)
    push!(z_coords, z_vec[j] * 1e9) # Rescales to nm
    push!(y_coords, y_vec[i] * 1e9)
    push!(Hz_a_vals, Hz_analytical[i, j])
    push!(Hy_a_vals, Hy_analytical[i, j])
end

arrow_length = 50
max_amp = maximum(sqrt.(Hz_a_vals.^2 + Hy_a_vals.^2))
Hz_a_scaled = (Hz_a_vals ./ max_amp) .* arrow_length
Hy_a_scaled = (Hy_a_vals ./ max_amp) .* arrow_length

analytical_plot = quiver(
    z_coords, 
    y_coords, 
    quiver=(Hz_a_scaled, Hy_a_scaled), 
    color=:blue, 
    linewidth=1.5, 
    label="Analytical H-Field"
)

plot!(analytical_plot, 
    xlabel="Propagation Distance - Z [nm]", 
    ylabel="Distance - Y [nm]", 
    title="Plot of Analytical H-Field Solution at t=0", 
    legend=:topright,                       # Not sure why the legend is not working
    aspect_ratio=:equal
)

display(analytical_plot)

c.) Numerical solution from finite difference approximation

# Makes the phasor grid
E_phasor_grid = zeros(ComplexF64, Ny, Nz)
for i in 1:Ny, j in 1:Nz
    # E_phasor = E_0 * sin(beta*y) * e^(-j*beta*z)
    E_phasor_grid[i, j] = E_0 * sin(beta * y_vec[i]) * exp(-im * beta * z_vec[j])
end

Hy_numerical = zeros(Ny, Nz)
Hz_numerical = zeros(Ny, Nz)

for i in 2:(Ny-1)
    for j in 2:(Nz-1)
        dEx_dz_complex = (E_phasor_grid[i, j+1] - E_phasor_grid[i, j-1]) / (2 * dz)
        dEx_dy_complex = (E_phasor_grid[i+1, j] - E_phasor_grid[i-1, j]) / (2 * dy)
        
        Hy_phasor = (im / (omega * mu_0)) * dEx_dz_complex
        Hz_phasor = -(im / (omega * mu_0)) * dEx_dy_complex

        Hy_numerical[i, j] = real(Hy_phasor)
        Hz_numerical[i, j] = real(Hz_phasor)
    end
end

Hz_n_vals = Float64[]
Hy_n_vals = Float64[]

for i in 2:(Ny-1), j in 2:(Nz-1)
    push!(Hz_n_vals, Hz_numerical[i, j])
    push!(Hy_n_vals, Hy_numerical[i, j])
end


Hz_n_scaled = (Hz_n_vals ./ max_amp) .* arrow_length
Hy_n_scaled = (Hy_n_vals ./ max_amp) .* arrow_length

analytical_plot = quiver(
    z_coords, 
    y_coords, 
    quiver=(Hz_a_scaled, Hy_a_scaled), 
    color=:blue, 
    linewidth=1.5, 
    label="Analytical H-Field")

quiver!(
    z_coords, 
    y_coords, 
    quiver=(Hz_n_scaled, Hy_n_scaled), 
    color=:red, 
    linestyle=:dash, 
    linewidth=1.0, 
    label="Numerical H-Field"
    )

plot!(analytical_plot, 
      xlabel="Propagation Distance - Z [nm]", 
      ylabel="Distance - Y [nm]", 
      title="Comparison of Analytical and Numerical H-Field <br> Solutions at t=0", 
      legend=:topright,                         # Again not sure why the legend isn't working, but the numerical solution are the red lines
      aspect_ratio=:equal)

display(analytical_plot)
